summary: Australian cruiserweight Jai Opetaia improved to 24-0 with a first-round knockout of Englishman Ellis Zorro on the 'Day of Reckoning' card in Riyadh, after being stripped of his IBF title in controversial circumstances. On the same card, Joseph Parker upset Deontay Wilder and Anthony Joshua stopped Otto Wallin, with the results shaping upcoming heavyweight fights including Tyson Fury vs Oleksandr Usyk on February 17.
one_line: Jai Opetaia knocked out Ellis Zorro in round one in Riyadh to go 24-0, while Parker upset Wilder and Joshua stopped Wallin.
key_facts: Jai Opetaia knocked out Ellis Zorro with a huge left hand four seconds before the end of the first round in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Opetaia moved to 24-0 with 19 stoppages and retained his Ring Magazine belt; it was Zorro's first loss in 18 professional fights.
Opetaia had to vacate his IBF world cruiserweight title to take part in the card, after being stripped of IBF status in controversial circumstances.
The bout was reportedly worth $680,000 to Opetaia.
Opetaia broke his jaw twice while upsetting Mairis Briedis to win the IBF and Ring belts last year, then waited 14 months to defend them.
Opetaia's next fight could be on the Tyson Fury-Oleksandr Usyk card in Riyadh on February 17.
Promoter Eddie Hearn said Opetaia could replicate Usyk's career by unifying the cruiserweight division before moving up to heavyweight.
Joseph Parker (34-3-0), 31, dominated 38-year-old Deontay Wilder and was a big underdog according to FanDuel Sportsbook.
Anthony Joshua (27-3-0) beat Otto Wallin (26-2-0) by fifth-round TKO after a right-left combination; Wallin's corner called the stoppage.
The Wilder-Joshua bout expected for March is now uncertain, with Parker positioned to step up; the heavyweight division hasn't been unified this century.
Dmitrii Bivol beat Lyndon Arthur by unanimous decision, with all three judges scoring all 12 rounds for him.
Daniel Dubois stopped Jarrell Miller with a 10th-round TKO with eight seconds left; Agit Kabayel, Filip Hrgovic and Frank Sanchez also won by stoppage.
